selectedStyle: Modular monolith with ASP.NET minimal APIs

alternatives.name: Microservices
cons: Operational overhead unjustified for a v1 shortener

adrs.title: Use ASP.NET minimal APIs on .NET 10
adrs.context: The service exposes two small HTTP endpoints.
adrs.decision: Adopt minimal APIs rather than MVC controllers.

adrs.title: Abstract storage behind ILinkStore
adrs.context: Storage is in-memory for v1 but must be replaceable.
adrs.decision: Introduce an ILinkStore interface with an InMemoryLinkStore implementation.
adrs.consequences: A database-backed store can be added later without touching the API layer.

adrs.title: Random collision-checked short codes
adrs.context: Codes must be URL-safe, 6-8 characters, and collision-free.
adrs.decision: Generate 7-character URL-safe codes and retry on the rare collision.

components.name: Api
components.responsibility: HTTP endpoints, URL validation, and short-URL construction

components.name: LinkStore
components.responsibility: Create and resolve links; generate codes

techStack.rationale: No external database for v1; interface keeps it swappable.
